contentGate.clean: Selected Clean, navigated to the same Spicy challenge: explicit content error and zero media elements mounted.

limitations: No physical microphone or input device is attached to cloud Chrome. This is browser media playback verification, not real-device microphone or acting testing.
Browser runtime advertises no viewport resize capability; a narrow/mobile screenshot was not available.

defectFixedAndVerified.problem: Spicy challenge links were rejected even when Spicy was selected because frontend challenge reads omitted maxRating and server safely defaulted to everyone.
defectFixedAndVerified.fix: Pass the current content preference in all three challenge reads; keep the server content gate.
defectFixedAndVerified.regression: New component test proves Clean cannot mount the Spicy scene, then clicking Spicy retries with teen and opens the challenge. Six focused tests and edited-file lint passed.
defectFixedAndVerified.liveResult: Verified on final deployment: Clean blocks media; explicit Spicy choice opens the same link and survives refresh.

browserControlLimitations: Two browser-control protocol timeouts occurred on a click and scroll; inspecting state then using the supported controls resumed verification. No app or media error was observed from these runtime timeouts.
